summary: The PR addresses the issue by handling empty arrays specifically in the StrCategoryConverter class, which prevents the deprecation warning from being raised when plotting empty data with category units.

issues.description: The addition of a new file, reproduce_bug.py, is not part of the source code change and should not be included in the diff as per the instructions.
The added comments could be slightly improved for clarity, such as specifying why the empty array check is necessary.
